one_line: A royal stable physician from the Shalihotra veterinary tradition, tending warhorses along North Indian cavalry routes.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, lean and wiry with a sturdy, outdoors-trained build.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium brown North Indian complexion, straight nose, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes with dark hazel irises, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm focused default expression that softens when interacting with animals.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair tied in a short, tidy topknot at the back of the crown; front hair smoothed back; a simple off-white cotton patka (headcloth strip) wrapped low around the head like a narrow band, knotted at the back.
appearance.costume: Kushan–Gupta-era North Indian healer’s outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic crossing left over right and tied with inner and outer cloth ties, with a very light beige border; over this, a soft, narrow, mid-thigh–length ochre cotton uttariya draped from the left shoulder across the chest and around the back; slim but comfortable un-dyed cotton churidar-style trousers gathered at the ankles; simple dark brown leather sandals with a toe loop and heel strap; a plain narrow brown leather belt at the waist holding small pouches; minimal jewellery—a single thin copper bangle on his right wrist and a small wooden bead necklace; overall textiles are plain-weave cotton, slightly worn from stable work, with no heavy ornamentation.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf veterinary manuscript secured with a thin cord and tucked into his belt, alongside a small dark-wood horse-care kit: a short bronze-tipped diagnostic probe and a flat wooden spatula in a compact leather sheath carried at his left hip.

ref_desc: Shalihotra Vaidya is a lean, medium-brown North Indian man in his early 30s with a neat short beard, dark topknot under an off-white headband, wearing an off-white wrap tunic, ochre draped shawl, slim off-white trousers, brown sandals, and carrying a rolled palm-leaf veterinary manuscript with a small dark-wood horse-care kit at his belt in off-white, ochre, beige, and dark brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Shalihotra Vaidya: a lean, medium-brown North Indian man in his early 30s with an oval face, thoughtful hazel eyes, straight nose, and a neat short beard and moustache, his default expression calm and focused as if observing an animal; his dark brown-black hair is tied in a small topknot at the back of the crown with the front smoothed back, and a narrow off-white cotton headcloth band (patka) is wrapped low around his head and knotted at the back. He wears a historically grounded Kushan–Gupta-era outfit: a knee-length off-white cotton angarkha-style wrap tunic that crosses left over right, tied with visible cloth ties and edged with a very light beige border, over which a soft narrow ochre cotton uttariya shawl is draped from his left shoulder across the chest and around the back; his trousers are slim, un-dyed off-white cotton gathered at the ankles like churidar, and his footwear consists of simple dark brown leather sandals with a toe loop and heel strap. At his waist is a plain narrow brown leather belt supporting a couple of small pouches and his signature tools: a rolled palm-leaf manuscript bound with a thin cord tucked at his right side, and at his left hip a compact dark-wood horse-care kit in a leather sheath containing a short bronze-tipped diagnostic probe and flat wooden spatula, all rendered in a limited palette of off-white, ochre, light beige, medium brown, and dark brown, with clean lines and consistent details suitable for redrawing across many panels.
